2-3 [[Plant Fiber]]s | render = [[File:Seed Item.jpg|60px]] }} [[Sentient Seed]]s are a type of [[trophy]] item that [[drop]]s from various [[plant]]s found on [[Istan]]. According to [[Sehyal]], they are the only antidote for a love potion. [[Jidun]] says they are also used for a mind control potion, while [[Paljab]] claims that they can be used to counteract such a potion. == Acquisition == * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Istan]] *** [[Beautiful Iboga]] *** [[Fanged Iboga]] - levels 6 (23) and 10 (24) *** [[Stormseed Jacaranda]] - levels 6 (23) and 10 (24) ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Sentient Seed#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Fahranur, The First City]]==== Enter from [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]]. Most of them are in the southern edge of the map. [[File:Sentient seed farm.jpg|thumb|left]] {{clear}} == Collectors == {{:Paljab/Collector}} {{:Sehyal/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|8th August 2011 and 6th February 2012|Fahranur, The First City|3 [[Sentient Seed]]s}} == Notes == *The collector [[Sehyal]] trades 3 Sentient Seeds for items that are sold by a merchant for 100 {{gold}}. This provides a return that is over two and a half times more than just selling the trophies by themselves. They can alternatively be salvaged for common crafting materials which could be of use.
